key_insight: The paper simplifies qudit measurement-based quantum computing flow, proves focused flow is canonical, and improves flow-finding to O(n^3) for prime-dimensional qudit graph states.
engineering_relevance: This makes adaptive qudit circuit design and optimization more practical, enabling faster verification and automated generation of large measurement-based quantum computations.
method: Redefines qudit flow in a simpler, more workable form.
Shows how to focus flow and proves focused flow is canonical.
Derives an improved algebraic formulation and an O(n^3) flow-finding algorithm, plus flow-preserving graph transformations.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a complexity improvement from the previous O(n^4) qudit result to O(n^3), matching the best known qubit-case complexity.
watch_item: The results apply to prime-dimensional qudits and rely on structural conditions for flow, so not every resource graph will admit a directly usable flow construction.
paper_title: Working with measurement-based computations on qudits
